assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is medically necessary to capture potential arrhythmic events.
The service was ordered to correlate the patient's intermittent symptoms with cardiac rhythm.
This is consistent with the documented indication for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
The service is mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The patient may submit a formal appeal within ninety days of the notice.
